seo.metaDescription: House construction in Perambur from our head office here: narrow-lane rebuilds, demolition and plinth decisions, priced as a named line. Book a site visit.

excerpt: Most Perambur builds replace an older house on a small plot in a narrow lane. This guide covers what that changes, what to ask any builder, and how we price the work from our Perambur head office.
faqTitle: Building in Perambur: questions owners ask

faqs.question: Where is your nearest office to a Perambur site?
faqs.answer: Our head office is in Perambur, with our branch office in Sembiam and corporate office in Kolathur close by. Being this near is what makes frequent senior site visits practical on a tight Perambur job.

faqs.question: What do your construction packages cost for a Perambur house?
faqs.answer: Our packages are priced per sq ft of built-up area: Basic ₹2,199, Standard ₹2,399, Premium ₹2,699 and Ultra Luxury ₹3,199. Approvals, soil test, compound wall, sump and interiors are quoted separately. On most Perambur plots we also list demolition, debris disposal and any access premium for a narrow lane as separate lines, so the rate is not hiding them.

faqs.question: Who approves a house plan in Perambur?
faqs.answer: For a typical individual house in Perambur, the building permit comes from the Greater Chennai Corporation; larger buildings go to CMDA. We prepare the drawings and handle the submission, with the approval fees quoted separately.

faqs.question: Can you build on a Perambur plot a transit mixer cannot reach?
faqs.answer: Yes. Concrete is then mixed on site and materials arrive in smaller loads, which needs closer supervision of every mix. The extra handling appears as a named access line in our quote rather than inside the per sq ft rate.

faqs.question: Which unseen items decide whether a Perambur house lasts?
faqs.answer: Proper curing time on every slab, waterproofing that has not been cut back to save money, and enough supervision that nobody improvises on site. None of these show at handover, so ask any builder how they handle each one.
